title: Essential smallness of fixed-boundary cocones with essentially small apices
statement: Use universes, local smallness and essential smallness of [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category], and coherent diagrams, full subcategories, equivalences and cocone categories of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $\mathcal C$ be a locally small quasicategory and $D\subseteq\mathcal C$ an essentially small replete full subcategory. Let $K$ be a small simplicial set and $p:K\to D$ a coherent diagram. Write $j:D\hookrightarrow\mathcal C$ for the inclusion and $Q_D\subseteq\mathcal C_{jp/}$ for the full subcategory of cocones with apex in $D$. The induced functor $D_{p/}\to Q_D$ is an equivalence, and $Q_D$ is essentially small. Neither accessibility of $\mathcal C$ nor compactness of the values of $p$ nor existence of any colimits is assumed. The empty shape $K$ and the empty subcategory $D$ are allowed whenever $p$ exists.
